test_cases.name: Synthetic data creation
test_cases.expected: All synthetic files generated with fake labels
test_cases.actual: 8 files generated successfully without real credentials

test_cases.name: All 16 dashboard and management templates render
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with proper HTML

test_cases.name: Executable presence and size
test_cases.expected: File exists > 15MB

test_cases.name: Configuration persistence and separation
test_cases.expected: Loads from user home profile

test_cases.name: Sequential registration of MEC 01 and MEC 02
test_cases.expected: Both get distinct unique device IDs

test_cases.name: Rejection of already-used pairing code
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request
test_cases.actual: HTTP 400: Invalid or already-used pairing code
test_cases.recommendation: Enforce one-time use of pairing codes to prevent device impersonation

test_cases.name: Valid telemetry heartbeat marks agents ONLINE
test_cases.expected: is_online == True for both
test_cases.actual: Agent1 online: True, Agent2 online: True

test_cases.name: MEC 01 becomes OFFLINE while MEC 02 remains ONLINE
test_cases.expected: MEC 01 OFFLINE, MEC 02 ONLINE

test_cases.name: MEC 01 recovery back to ONLINE
test_cases.expected: MEC 01 restored to ONLINE

test_cases.name: SHA-256 file integrity check during cloud storage upload
test_cases.expected: Original hash == Received hash

test_cases.name: Unicode and spaces in uploaded filenames
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201 Created safely handled

test_cases.name: Path traversal injection in uploaded filenames
test_cases.expected: Treated as object metadata; no local filesystem traversal escape
test_cases.recommendation: Sanitize filenames to base names with secure filename utilities

test_cases.name: Password hashing algorithm in MySQL user store
test_cases.input: 3 human users with PBKDF2 hashes, 15 agent service accounts
test_cases.expected: Human users PBKDF2 hashed; agent accounts use unusable passwords + token auth
test_cases.actual: All human passwords hashed: True (PBKDF2), Service accounts token-only: True

test_cases.name: Absence of hardcoded production secrets in repository
test_cases.expected: Zero hardcoded production cloud credentials

test_cases.name: SQL injection resilience on ORM parameterized queries
test_cases.input: ["' OR 1=1 --", '" OR ""="', '1; DROP TABLE tasks_task;', "' UNION SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL --"]
test_cases.expected: Clean HTTP 404 / 400 rejection with no 500 SQL syntax errors
test_cases.recommendation: Maintain Django ORM parameterized queries across all endpoints

test_cases.name: RBAC & Unauthenticated API access blocking
test_cases.input: Anonymous & Normal User requests to protected areas
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401/403 for API, 302 redirect for admin
test_cases.actual: Anon API tasks: 403, Norm user admin: 302

test_cases.name: HTTP method restrictions and malformed JSON parsing
test_cases.expected: Method Not Allowed (405) and Bad Request (400)

test_cases.name: Clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options header)
test_cases.expected: Header present (DENY or SAMEORIGIN)

test_cases.name: Harmless script injection in task name rendered in dashboard
test_cases.expected: Script tags escaped in HTML template output
test_cases.recommendation: Maintain Django auto-escaping in all template rendering contexts

test_cases.name: Enforcement of CSRF token on state-changing web POST
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden

test_cases.name: Double extension handling (harmless.php.txt)
test_cases.expected: Treated purely as data, not executed as PHP
test_cases.actual: HTTP 201: Stored safely with mime text/plain

test_cases.name: Complete task state progression (PENDING -> QUEUED -> ASSIGNED -> COMPLETED)
test_cases.expected: Full state transition lifecycle verified
test_cases.actual: QUEUED: True, ASSIGNED: True, COMPLETED: True

test_cases.name: Virtual replica synchronization with database MECs
test_cases.expected: Digital Twin reflects LOCAL, CLOUD, and registered MECs

test_cases.name: GA optimization vs Random/Greedy baselines
test_cases.expected: GA executes selection, crossover, mutation, convergence

test_cases.name: Dynamic threat classification thresholds
test_cases.expected: LOW, MEDIUM, CRITICAL levels

test_cases.name: Simulated DDoS attack and automated mitigation response
test_cases.expected: Risk inflated -> status escalated -> mitigated -> restored

test_cases.name: API state and telemetry responses redact credentials
test_cases.expected: No password or secret exposure in JSON payload

test_cases.name: Automated requeuing of tasks when MEC drops offline
test_cases.expected: Task status reset to QUEUED and unassigned

test_cases.name: Google Drive simulation mode and metadata tracking
test_cases.expected: Mode is simulation and file metadata returned

test_cases.name: Task queue state transition history records
test_cases.expected: At least 2 state transitions logged in TaskQueueHistory

test_cases.name: Analytics overview API endpoint latency
test_cases.expected: Response time < 200ms

test_cases.name: GA Scheduler scaling under 10, 50, 100 tasks
test_cases.expected: 100 tasks scheduled under 2.0s without memory crash

test_cases.name: Binary inspection for hardcoded private keys or production secrets
test_cases.expected: Zero embedded private keys or production secrets
test_cases.recommendation: Ensure PyInstaller bundles only runtime logic without embedding secrets

test_cases.name: Automated avoidance of compromised node during dispatch
test_cases.expected: GA scheduler avoids high-risk node and assigns task to healthy node
